caption: The drawing depicts a single object, which appears to be a lantern or lamp, centered on a plain, light beige background. The object consists of two main sections: the upper section is made of metal and features a conical top with a circular handle attached at the peak by a hinge. Below the conical top, there is a cylindrical section with a horizontal band and a row of small, evenly spaced diamond-shaped perforations encircling it. The lower section is a bulbous, transparent, glass reservoir that narrows at the top and bottom, creating a shape similar to an hourglass. A vertical metal band runs from the top metal section down the side of the glass body, providing structural support. The bottom terminates in a short, circular foot made of metal. The entire drawing is rendered in grayscale, with detailed shading and highlights to indicate the reflective metallic and glass surfaces. There are no additional objects or features in the composition other than the subject itself.
title: Ship's Lantern
